entries.name: KOREA SAMJONG SHIPPING

addresses.text: Tonghung-dong, Chung-guyok, Pyongyang, Democratic People's Republic of Korea

entries.remarks: Registered owner of DPRK tankers SAM JONG 1 and SAM JONG 2. Both vessels are believed to have imported refined petroleum to DPRK in violation of UN sanctions in late January 2018. IMO number: 5954061.

entries.name: BUTEMBO AIRLINES (BAL)

addresses.text: Butembo, Democratic Republic of the Congo

entries.remarks: Privately-owned airline, operates out of Butembo. Since December 2008, BAL no longer holds an aircraft operating license in the DRC. INTERPOL-UN Security Council Special Notice:https://www.interpol.int/en/How-we-work/Notices/View-UN-Notices-Entities

entries.name: ADF
aliases: Forces Démocratiques Alliées-Armée Nationale de Libération de l’Ouganda

addresses.text: North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo

entries.remarks: ADF founder and leader, Jamil Mukulu (CDi.015), was arrested in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania in April 2015. He was subsequently extradited to Kampala, Uganda in July 2015. As of June 2016, Mukulu is reportedly being held in a police detention cell awaiting his trial. Seka Baluku (CDi.036) succeeded Jamil Mukulu (CDi.015) as the overall leader of the ADF.
